growth_areas.label: Concision
growth_areas.description: Was Sam succinct? Did he ramble or repeat points? Cite specific moments where he could have been briefer and suggest a tighter version.

growth_areas.label: Structured Thinking
growth_areas.description: Were ideas presented logically? Did he use frameworks or clear sequencing? Cite scattered moments and suggest how to structure them.

growth_areas.label: Empathy & Listening
growth_areas.description: Did Sam acknowledge others' points before responding? Did he ask questions? Cite missed opportunities and suggest alternatives.
